title: Design System: VCG — Value Creation Group

display.purpose: Hero headings only. One per page. The optical size 144 opens Fraunces to its most generous, open form — near-monumental at maximum scale.
display.notes: font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 144 is non-negotiable. Without it the heading looks identical to body-scaled Fraunces.

headline.purpose: Section headings. Never italicised in this role. The opsz 72 setting gives structural weight without the open letterforms of display.

title.purpose: Subsection labels, stat numerals, emphasis callouts. The slight weight increase to 400 at opsz 36 is deliberate — the axis makes it feel decisive.

body.purpose: All prose. Max 68ch line length. Fraunces at opsz 12 is the voice of the site — warm, dense, careful.
body.notes: font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 12. Line length enforced at max-width: 68ch.

label.purpose: Eyebrows above statistics, navigation links, table column heads, footnote attributions. Uppercase, tracked. Never in paragraph prose.
label.notes: JetBrains Mono only. Prohibition on paragraph use is absolute.

shadows.name: nav-anchor
shadows.purpose: Fixed navigation bar only, on scroll. Warm-tinted using Press Ink at 8% opacity. Grounds the nav as the persistent layer above changing content. The only shadow in the system.

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: Default easing for all reveal animations. Slow, unhurried — matches the reading register of the site. Not a snappy product ease.

motion.name: reveal-duration
motion.purpose: Duration for section reveal animations (opacity + translateY 8px). Staggered delays: first element at 0ms, each subsequent +80ms.

motion.name: transition-standard
motion.purpose: Interactive state transitions — button hover, link colour change, card hover treatment. Faster than reveal; these are responses to input, not entrances.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Primary layout shift. Three-column figures collapse to one. Navigation may adapt.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Full mobile layout. Hero padding reduces. All multi-column grids become single-column.

narrative.overview:
The design system reads like a letter that wasn't written for general circulation. The surface — warm bond paper, dense ink, no embellishment — says: this was composed for one specific reader who already qualifies. Authority is assumed, not established. The site does not explain itself to the uninitiated; it speaks directly to the person who already recognises the problem.

Three visual moves enforce this. First, ink on paper — the classic weight of record. No colour decorates; every pixel of colour carries semantic load. Second, Fraunces at full optical scale — a variable typeface used at both its upper limit (hero display, opsz 144, barely tracked, almost monumental) and its lower limit (body prose, opsz 12, optically tuned for the reading distance of a briefing document). Third, no radius anywhere — sharp corners throughout, the register of the typed memorandum, not the tech product.

This is not the editorial-magazine lane. The warm palette earns its warmth through functional hierarchy. The colour green is present and controlled: used on all interactive states and structural anchors, restrained everywhere else. The terracotta CTA carries the warmth of invitation, not the urgency of acquisition.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-on-paper surface discipline: colour only where it signals meaning
Zero radius throughout — the artefact aesthetic, not the product aesthetic
Fraunces variable driven by optical-size axis: three characters from one typeface
Present-but-controlled colour: green for all interactive states, terracotta for all CTAs
One structural shadow only, on the fixed navigation
Motion restrained to a single reveal pattern; reduced-motion honoured absolutely

rules.name: The One-Function Rule
rules.body: Each colour role is exclusive. Green appears on interactive states and structural anchors only — never on decorative headings, never on backgrounds. Terracotta appears on CTAs only. If you reach for green to add personality to a heading, stop.

rules.name: The Optical-Size Doctrine
rules.body: The variable axis 'opsz' is non-negotiable. Every Fraunces instance must declare its optical size via font-variation-settings. Display: opsz 144. Headline: opsz 72. Title: opsz 36. Body: opsz 12. Missing it collapses all weights to an indistinguishable midpoint.

rules.name: The Mono Restriction
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is prohibited in paragraph prose. It may only appear in label roles — short, often uppercase, clearly structured context. A sentence in mono reads as costume; a label in mono reads as precision.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The one nav shadow exists because the nav is a persistent layer above changing content — it needs functional grounding, not visual interest. No card, section, or content element in the scroll stream gets a shadow. A shadow added for visual interest is the wrong answer.

dos: Do use Deal Room Forest (#1E4A3A) on all interactive states — links, hover treatments, section anchors, navigation.
Do set font-variation-settings: 'opsz' N on every Fraunces instance. The optical size axis is the hierarchy.
Do carry a named source on every statistic. The source is the artefact; the artefact is the trust mechanism.
Do keep JetBrains Mono to label roles — eyebrows above figures, navigation links, table column heads. Nothing in paragraph prose.
Do let the dark contact section be the only full-register reversal. One is a deliberate accent; two implies a pattern.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion absolutely. The reveal animation must instantly resolve for users who opt out.
Do cap body prose at 68ch line length.
Do write copy that assumes the reader already understands the problem.
donts: Don't add a tagline. The wordmark stands alone. Remove 'The executive claims the deal' from meta, OG, hero H1, and footer.
Don't write copy that could appear on any Big-4 or McKinsey advisory site. Every sentence must be specific to VCG's mechanism.
Don't use border-left coloured stripes on cards, callouts, or list items.
Don't add a shadow to cards, sections, or content containers. The Flat-By-Default Rule is absolute.
Don't render statistics without named sources.
Don't add a third typeface. Fraunces and JetBrains Mono are the system.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, large rounded-corner icon badges, or identical card grids.
Don't explain VCG to an audience that doesn't already know.
Don't optimise for the wrong reader. The site generates one outcome: a qualified first conversation.
